questions.passage:
For several decades, health researchers have examined whether the number of patients assigned to each nurse affects what happens to those patients. The question is not merely academic, because nursing salaries account for a large share of hospital budgets, and administrators under financial pressure have sometimes sought savings by reducing the number of registered nurses on wards or by replacing some of them with less qualified staff.
A considerable body of observational research suggests that such savings may carry a hidden cost. Studies conducted in North America, Europe and elsewhere have found that, in hospitals where each nurse is responsible for more patients, surgical patients are somewhat more likely to die within thirty days of admission. A related finding concerns what researchers call failure to rescue, namely death following a complication, such as an infection or internal bleeding, that might have been treated successfully had it been recognised in time. Because nurses are the professionals who observe patients most continuously, the detection of subtle signs of deterioration, such as a rising breathing rate or growing confusion, depends heavily on whether they have enough time to do so. When workloads are excessive, necessary care may be delayed or left undone altogether, a phenomenon that nurses themselves frequently report.
Interpreting this evidence is not straightforward. Hospitals with generous staffing may differ from others in many respects, including their wealth, their technology and the seriousness of the cases they admit, and not all of these differences can be fully adjusted for statistically. Partly for this reason, policymakers have reached different conclusions. A few jurisdictions, notably the state of California, have introduced legally mandated minimum nurse-to-patient ratios, while others prefer more flexible tools that adjust staffing to the needs of patients on a given shift. What most researchers agree on is that the education of nurses matters as well as their number: wards with a higher proportion of nurses holding university degrees tend to report better outcomes.

questions.passage:
Patients often respond very differently to the same dose of the same medicine. In one person a standard dose relieves symptoms with no ill effects; in another it brings little benefit; in a third it causes serious harm. Age, body weight, kidney and liver function and the use of other drugs all contribute to this variation, but a growing body of research indicates that inherited differences also play a substantial part. The study of how genes influence the response to drugs is known as pharmacogenomics.
Codeine provides a particularly instructive example. The drug itself is a weak painkiller; it becomes effective largely after an enzyme in the liver, known as CYP2D6, converts a portion of it into morphine. The gene that encodes this enzyme exists in many variants. People who inherit two inactive copies convert little or no codeine and therefore gain scant relief from it, whereas so-called ultra-rapid metabolisers, who carry extra functional copies, produce morphine unusually quickly. In the latter group, even ordinary doses can lead to dangerous levels of morphine, causing excessive sedation and, in rare cases, a fatal slowing of breathing. The frequency of these variants differs considerably between populations. Following reports of deaths among young children, regulators in several countries restricted the use of codeine in children.
Testing patients' genes before prescribing seems an obvious solution, and for a small number of drug–gene pairs it is already recommended. Its wider adoption, however, has been slower than many enthusiasts predicted. Tests add cost and, unless results are available before the first dose, may delay treatment; many doctors receive little training in interpreting them; and for numerous drugs the evidence that testing improves outcomes remains incomplete. One proposed solution is to test patients once, in advance, and to store the results in their electronic health records, so that they can be consulted automatically whenever a relevant drug is prescribed.

İki etkisiz kopya taşıyanlar (‘inactive’) tam tersine çok az rahatlama sağlar; kodein enzimi engellemez (‘blocks’), enzim tarafından dönüştürülür; varyantların sıklığı topluluklara göre değiştiği için etkinin her toplulukta aynı (‘same degree’) olduğu söylenemez; başka ağrı kesicilerle birleştirme (‘combined’) metinde geçmez.

questions.explanation: Özne tekil ‘A considerable body of research’ olduğu için yüklem tekil olmalıdır ve araştırmaların etkisi bugüne uzandığı için ‘has cast’ (kuşku düşürmüştür) doğrudur. ‘Have cast’ çoğul özneye uyar; ‘casting’ ve ‘to cast’ cümleyi yüklemsiz bırakır; ‘had been cast’ ise edilgendir ve ‘doubt’ nesnesiyle çelişir.

questions.passage: Grade retention, the practice of requiring a pupil who has fallen behind to repeat a school year, has long been (1) ---- on the assumption that an additional year will allow the child to master material that was not learned the first time. A considerable body of research, however, (2) ---- doubt on this assumption. Many studies have found that any initial gains in achievement tend to fade within two or three years, (3) ---- retained pupils are more likely than comparable peers to leave school without a qualification. Critics also point to the emotional costs, since being separated from one's classmates may be experienced as a public mark of failure. (4) ----, the evidence is not entirely one-sided, as a few studies suggest that retention in the earliest grades, when combined with targeted support, can be beneficial. What appears to matter most, many researchers conclude, is not whether a pupil repeats a year but (5) ---- the extra time is actually used.
questions.text: (3) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: and
unless
so that
even though
as if
questions.explanation: Kazanımların kaybolması ile tekrar eden öğrencilerin okulu bırakma olasılığının yüksek olması aynı yönde iki olumsuz bulgudur; bu yüzden ekleme bağlacı ‘and’ gelir. ‘Unless’ koşul, ‘so that’ amaç, ‘even though’ karşıtlık bildirir; ‘as if’ ise ‘sanki’ anlamı taşır ve bulguları birbirine bağlayamaz.

questions.passage: Grade retention, the practice of requiring a pupil who has fallen behind to repeat a school year, has long been (1) ---- on the assumption that an additional year will allow the child to master material that was not learned the first time. A considerable body of research, however, (2) ---- doubt on this assumption. Many studies have found that any initial gains in achievement tend to fade within two or three years, (3) ---- retained pupils are more likely than comparable peers to leave school without a qualification. Critics also point to the emotional costs, since being separated from one's classmates may be experienced as a public mark of failure. (4) ----, the evidence is not entirely one-sided, as a few studies suggest that retention in the earliest grades, when combined with targeted support, can be beneficial. What appears to matter most, many researchers conclude, is not whether a pupil repeats a year but (5) ---- the extra time is actually used.
questions.text: (4) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: Consequently
Nevertheless
Similarly
For example
In addition
questions.explanation: Önceki cümleler sınıf tekrarının olumsuz sonuçlarını sıralar; boşluktan sonra ise kanıtların tek yönlü olmadığı ve bazı yararların bulunduğu söylenir, bu yüzden karşıtlık bildiren ‘Nevertheless’ gerekir. ‘Consequently’ sonuç, ‘Similarly’ benzerlik, ‘For example’ örnek, ‘In addition’ ise ekleme bildirir.

questions.passage: Grade retention, the practice of requiring a pupil who has fallen behind to repeat a school year, has long been (1) ---- on the assumption that an additional year will allow the child to master material that was not learned the first time. A considerable body of research, however, (2) ---- doubt on this assumption. Many studies have found that any initial gains in achievement tend to fade within two or three years, (3) ---- retained pupils are more likely than comparable peers to leave school without a qualification. Critics also point to the emotional costs, since being separated from one's classmates may be experienced as a public mark of failure. (4) ----, the evidence is not entirely one-sided, as a few studies suggest that retention in the earliest grades, when combined with targeted support, can be beneficial. What appears to matter most, many researchers conclude, is not whether a pupil repeats a year but (5) ---- the extra time is actually used.
questions.text: (5) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: that
how
which
what
who
questions.explanation: ‘Not whether … but how …’ yapısı önemli olanın tekrar edilip edilmemesi değil, ek sürenin nasıl kullanıldığı olduğunu anlatır; tam bir cümleyi (‘the extra time is actually used’) bağlayan ‘how’ doğrudur. ‘That’ ‘whether’ ile paralellik kurmaz; ‘which’ ve ‘what’ eksik öğeli bir cümle ister; ‘who’ ise kişiler için kullanılır.

questions.text: Although the minimum school-leaving age was raised in many countries during the early twentieth century, ----.
options: because governments had invested heavily in the training of teachers
the law was therefore enforced strictly in every region
which was welcomed by most industrial employers at the time
attendance in rural areas often remained irregular because children were needed for agricultural work
unless parents could prove that their children were being educated at home
questions.explanation: ‘Although’ ile kurulan yan cümle beklenmedik bir sonuç bildiren ana cümle ister: Yasa okul yaşını yükseltse de kırsalda devam düzensiz kalmıştır. ‘Because’ ve ‘unless’ ile başlayanlar yeni bir yan cümledir, ana cümle kurmaz; ‘therefore’ karşıtlık yerine sonuç bildirerek ‘although’ ile çelişir; ‘which’ ile başlayan ilgi cümlesi de ana cümle oluşturmaz.

questions.text: Individuals tend to exert less effort on a group task ----.
options: unless the task had been completed before the deadline
when they believe that their personal contribution cannot be identified
so that their own effort will be noticed by the others
although they had been rewarded on an individual basis
which is why groups always outperform individuals
questions.explanation: Grup içinde daha az çaba gösterme, kişinin kendi katkısının ayırt edilemeyeceğine inandığı durumlarla açıklanır; ‘when they believe … cannot be identified’ bu koşulu verir. ‘Deadline’ içeren seçenek geçmiş bitmiş zamanla uyuşmaz; çabanın ‘noticed’ olması amacı az çaba göstermeyle çelişir; ‘rewarded’ seçeneği zaman uyumsuzdur; grupların her zaman daha başarılı (‘outperform’) olduğu sonucu da cümleden çıkmaz.

questions.text: The faster a currency loses its value, ----.
options: the more eager people become to exchange their savings for goods or foreign money
the most expensive imported goods have become
people had saved a larger share of their income
so that prices remain stable for several years
whereas inflation had already been brought under control
questions.explanation: ‘The faster …’ ile başlayan karşılaştırma yapısı ‘the more …’ ile tamamlanır: Para ne kadar hızlı değer kaybederse insanlar birikimlerini mala ya da dövize çevirmeye o kadar istekli olur. ‘The most expensive’ üstünlük bildirdiği için kalıba uymaz; birikimin arttığını söyleyen ‘saved’ seçeneği hem zaman hem anlam olarak yanlıştır; fiyatların ‘stable’ kalması ve enflasyonun ‘control’ altına alınması anlamla çelişir.

questions.text: ----, historians have been able to reconstruct the daily lives of ordinary people who left no written accounts of their own.
options: Unless parish registers had been destroyed during the war
So that the archives could be digitised more quickly
If historians had relied only on official chronicles
Since they were written mostly by members of the ruling elite
By analysing court records, tax registers and wills
questions.explanation: Kendi yazılı anlatısını bırakmamış insanların yaşamı, onlar hakkında tutulmuş belgeler incelenerek yeniden kurulabilir; ‘By analysing court records …’ bu yöntemi verir. ‘Unless … had been destroyed’ ve ‘If … had relied’ geçmişe ait gerçek dışı koşullardır, ana cümlenin ‘have been able’ yapısıyla uyuşmaz; ‘digitised’ amacı yeniden kurma işini açıklamaz; ‘Since they were written’ seçeneğindeki ‘they’ ise tarihçileri gösterir ve anlamsızdır.

questions.text: Once a social norm becomes widely accepted, ----.
options: individuals who violate it may face disapproval even in the absence of formal sanctions
it had rarely been enforced by any written law
although few people had actually followed it in practice
until the majority of the population decides to reject it
which explains why norms differ so greatly across cultures
questions.explanation: ‘Once’ (… olunca) ile kurulan zaman cümlesi genel bir sonuç bildiren ana cümle ister: Norm benimsenince onu çiğneyen kişiler resmî yaptırım olmasa da hoş karşılanmaz. ‘Enforced’ seçeneği geçmiş bitmiş zamandadır ve uyuşmaz; ‘although’ ve ‘until’ ile başlayanlar yan cümledir; ‘which explains’ ile başlayan ilgi cümlesi de ana cümle kurmaz ve ‘cultures’ farkı konuyla bağlantısızdır.

questions.text: Many developing economies remain highly vulnerable to sudden changes in commodity prices ----.
options: although they have diversified their industrial base considerably
unless the global economy had grown more slowly
so that foreign investors would have avoided them
that most wealthy countries import from them
because their export earnings depend on a small number of raw materials
questions.explanation: Emtia fiyatlarına karşı kırılganlığın nedeni, ihracat gelirinin birkaç hammaddeye bağlı olmasıdır; ‘because their export earnings depend …’ bu nedeni verir. Ekonominin ‘diversified’ olduğunu söylemek kırılganlıkla çelişir; ‘unless … had grown’ ve ‘would have avoided’ zaman ve anlam olarak uyuşmaz; ‘import from them’ ile biten ‘that’ cümlesi ise bağlanacak bir isim bulamaz.

questions.text: ---- that children from low-income families often start school with a smaller vocabulary, early-childhood programmes have been proposed as a way of reducing later inequalities.
options: Despite the fact
Even if it were doubtful
Unless researchers had shown
Given the consistent finding
In order to prove
questions.explanation: Okul öncesi programların önerilmesinin gerekçesi, düşük gelirli ailelerin çocuklarının daha az sözcükle okula başladığı bulgusudur; ‘Given the consistent finding’ (… tutarlı bulgu göz önüne alındığında) bu gerekçeyi kurar. ‘Despite the fact’ karşıtlık bildirerek ilişkiyi tersine çevirir; ‘Even if it were doubtful’ ve ‘Unless researchers had shown’ gerçek dışı koşullardır ve bulguya dayanmayı geçersiz kılar; ‘In order to prove’ ise ‘that’ ile bir bulguya bağlanamaz.

questions.text: Had the medieval craft associations not restricted entry into their trades, ----.
options: the price of manufactured goods will fall considerably
many young workers had already left for the countryside
their members would be protected from all competition
which kept the wages of their members artificially high
the supply of skilled workers in towns might have grown more rapidly
questions.explanation: ‘Had … not restricted’ geçmişe ait gerçek dışı bir koşuldur (third conditional) ve ‘might have grown’ ile tamamlanır: Girişi kısıtlamasalardı kentlerdeki nitelikli işçi arzı daha hızlı artabilirdi. ‘Will fall’ gerçek koşul yapısıdır; ‘had already left’ koşul cümlesine sonuç oluşturmaz; ‘would be protected’ hem zaman hem anlam olarak uyuşmaz, çünkü kısıtlama olmasaydı rekabet artardı; ‘which kept’ ile başlayan ilgi cümlesi ana cümle kurmaz.

questions.text: While some psychologists regard daydreaming as a waste of mental resources, ----.
options: because it occupies a large part of our waking hours
it had been studied mainly in children before the 1950s
unless it interferes with the performance of everyday tasks
which may explain why attention tends to decline in the afternoon
others argue that it plays a role in planning and creative problem-solving
questions.explanation: ‘While some …’ karşıtlık kurar ve ‘others argue …’ ile tamamlanır: Bazıları hayal kurmayı israf sayarken diğerleri onun planlama ve yaratıcılıktaki rolünü vurgular. ‘Because’ ve ‘unless’ ile başlayanlar yan cümledir; ‘studied mainly in children’ seçeneği karşıt bir görüş sunmaz ve zamanı uyumsuzdur; ‘afternoon’ ile biten ilgi cümlesi de ana cümle kurmaz.

questions.text: Rural populations in much of Western Europe declined sharply during the nineteenth century ----.
options: unless agricultural productivity had increased at the same time
so that the cities would have become less crowded
whereas urban populations fell even more steeply
as industrial cities attracted workers with the promise of regular wages
which had been governed for centuries by local landowners
questions.explanation: Kırsal nüfusun azalmasının nedeni, sanayi kentlerinin düzenli ücret vaadiyle işçi çekmesidir; neden bildiren ‘as industrial cities attracted …’ cümleyi tamamlar. ‘Unless … had increased’ ve ‘would have become’ zaman uyumsuzdur ve anlam vermez; kent nüfusunun daha hızlı düştüğünü (‘fell even more steeply’) söylemek tarihsel gerçeğe aykırıdır; ‘landowners’ ile biten ilgi cümlesi ise ‘the nineteenth century’ ifadesine anlamlı biçimde bağlanmaz.

questions.text: It is often assumed that higher incomes automatically bring greater happiness, ----.
options: since wealthy people tend to work longer hours than others
unless income had been distributed more equally
which was first proposed by ancient philosophers
but research suggests that the relationship becomes weaker once basic needs are met
so that most economists measure welfare by income alone
questions.explanation: ‘It is often assumed …’ yaygın bir varsayım sunar ve genellikle bu varsayımı sınırlayan bir karşıtlıkla tamamlanır: ‘but research suggests …’ ilişkinin temel ihtiyaçlar karşılandıktan sonra zayıfladığını söyler. Zenginlerin uzun çalışması (‘longer hours’) bir neden olarak varsayımı açıklamaz; ‘unless … had been distributed’ zaman uyumsuzdur; ‘philosophers’ ile biten ilgi cümlesi kanıt sunmaz; ‘so that’ ise amaç bildirerek anlamsız olur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

The extent to which a society values formal education is reflected not only in its public spending but also in the social status it grants to teachers.
options: Bir toplum örgün eğitime ne kadar çok harcama yaparsa öğretmenlerin toplumsal statüsü de o kadar yükselir.
Bir toplumun örgün eğitime ne ölçüde değer verdiği, yalnızca kamu harcamalarına değil, öğretmenlere tanıdığı toplumsal statüye de yansır.
Bir toplumda öğretmenlerin toplumsal statüsü, örgün eğitime ayrılan kamu harcamalarından daha önemlidir.
Örgün eğitime değer veren toplumlar, kamu harcamalarını öğretmenlerin toplumsal statüsünü artırmak için kullanır.
Bir toplumun örgün eğitime verdiği değer, öğretmenlerin toplumsal statüsünü belirleyen tek etkendir.
questions.explanation: ‘The extent to which … values’ (ne ölçüde değer verdiği), ‘is reflected not only in … but also in …’ (yalnızca … değil, … de yansır) ve ‘the social status it grants to teachers’ (öğretmenlere tanıdığı toplumsal statü) doğru karşılıkta eksiksizdir. ‘Yükselir’ diyen seçenek ‘ne kadar … o kadar’ ilişkisi kurar; statünün harcamalardan ‘önemlidir’ olduğu karşılaştırması, harcamaların bir amaç için ‘kullanır’ olduğu ve değerin ‘tek etkendir’ olduğu iddiası özgün cümlede yoktur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Had the land reforms been implemented more gradually, the resistance of the large landowners might have been less intense.
options: Toprak reformları daha aşamalı biçimde uygulanmış olsaydı, büyük toprak sahiplerinin direnişi daha az şiddetli olabilirdi.
Toprak reformları aşamalı biçimde uygulandığı için büyük toprak sahipleri bunlara pek direnmedi.
Büyük toprak sahiplerinin şiddetli direnişi, toprak reformlarının aşamalı olarak uygulanmasına yol açtı.
Toprak reformları daha hızlı uygulansaydı, büyük toprak sahipleri direnişlerini bırakmak zorunda kalırdı.
Büyük toprak sahipleri, toprak reformlarının daha yavaş uygulanması için hükümete baskı yaptı.
questions.explanation: ‘Had … been implemented more gradually’ geçmişe ait gerçek dışı bir koşuldur (daha aşamalı uygulanmış olsaydı) ve ‘might have been less intense’ (daha az şiddetli olabilirdi) ile tamamlanır; doğru karşılık budur. ‘Direnmedi’ diyen seçenek koşulu gerçekleşmiş bir neden yapar; direnişin aşamalı uygulamaya ‘açtı’ olduğu iddiası ilişkiyi tersine çevirir; ‘hızlı’ uygulama koşulu ve hükümete ‘baskı’ yapılması özgün cümlede yoktur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Some historians estimate that, contrary to popular belief, medieval peasants may have enjoyed more days of rest each year than many modern employees.
options: Bazı tarihçilere göre ortaçağ köylüleri, modern çalışanlar gibi yılın büyük bölümünde dinlenmeden çalışmak zorundaydı.
Yaygın inanca göre ortaçağ köylüleri modern çalışanlardan daha fazla tatil yapıyordu, ancak tarihçiler bunu reddetmektedir.
Bazı tarihçiler, modern çalışanların yılda ortaçağ köylülerinden daha fazla dinlenme hakkına sahip olduğunu kanıtlamıştır.
Ortaçağ köylülerinin dinlenme günlerinin sayısı, tarihçilerin yıllardır üzerinde uzlaştığı bir konudur.
Bazı tarihçiler, yaygın inancın aksine, ortaçağ köylülerinin her yıl pek çok modern çalışandan daha fazla dinlenme günü geçirmiş olabileceğini tahmin etmektedir.
questions.explanation: ‘Some historians estimate’ (bazı tarihçiler tahmin etmektedir), ‘contrary to popular belief’ (yaygın inancın aksine) ve ‘may have enjoyed more days of rest’ (daha fazla dinlenme günü geçirmiş olabileceğini) doğru karşılıkta vardır. Köylülerin ‘dinlenmeden’ çalıştığını söyleyen seçenek anlamı tersine çevirir; tarihçilerin ‘reddetmektedir’ demesi yaygın inanç ile tarihçi görüşünü karıştırır; ‘kanıtlamıştır’ hem ilişkiyi ters kurar hem temkini kaldırır; tarihçilerin ‘uzlaştığı’ iddiası da cümlede yoktur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

People tend to overestimate how much others notice their appearance and behaviour, a tendency that psychologists refer to as the spotlight effect.
options: Psikologlara göre spot ışığı etkisi, insanların başkalarının görünüş ve davranışlarını yanlış değerlendirmesine yol açar.
İnsanlar görünüş ve davranışlarının başkaları tarafından fark edilmediğini düşündüğünde spot ışığı etkisi ortaya çıkar.
Psikologlar, başkalarının görünüşüne dikkat eden insanların kendi davranışlarını daha az fark ettiğini öne sürmektedir.
Spot ışığı etkisi nedeniyle insanlar, görünüş ve davranışlarını değiştirmekten kaçınma eğilimi gösterir.
İnsanlar, başkalarının kendi görünüş ve davranışlarını ne kadar fark ettiğini abartma eğilimindedir; psikologlar bu eğilime spot ışığı etkisi adını verir.
questions.explanation: ‘Tend to overestimate’ (abartma eğilimindedir), ‘how much others notice their appearance and behaviour’ (başkalarının kendi görünüş ve davranışlarını ne kadar fark ettiğini) ve ‘refer to as the spotlight effect’ (spot ışığı etkisi adını verir) doğru karşılıkta eksiksizdir. Başkalarını ‘yanlış değerlendirmesine’ yol açtığını söyleyen seçenek yönü değiştirir; ‘edilmediğini’ diyen seçenek anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘dikkat eden’ insanlar karşılaştırması ve değiştirmekten ‘kaçınma’ sonucu cümlede yoktur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

The introduction of a single currency eliminated exchange-rate risk among member states, but it also deprived national governments of an important tool for responding to economic shocks.
options: Ortak para birimi, ulusal hükümetlerin ekonomik şoklara daha hızlı yanıt vermesini sağlayarak üye devletler arasındaki kur riskini azalttı.
Üye devletler arasındaki kur riskini ortadan kaldırmak için ulusal hükümetler, ekonomik şoklara karşı ortak bir araç geliştirdi.
Ortak para biriminin getirilmesi üye devletler arasındaki kur riskini ortadan kaldırdı, ancak ulusal hükümetleri ekonomik şoklara yanıt vermek için önemli bir araçtan da yoksun bıraktı.
Ortak para biriminin getirilmesine rağmen üye devletler arasındaki kur riski sürdü ve ulusal hükümetler şoklara yanıt veremedi.
Ulusal hükümetler, ekonomik şoklara yanıt verebilmek için ortak para biriminden ayrılmayı tartışmaya başladı.
questions.explanation: ‘Eliminated exchange-rate risk’ (kur riskini ortadan kaldırdı), ‘but it also deprived … of an important tool’ (ancak … önemli bir araçtan da yoksun bıraktı) ve ‘for responding to economic shocks’ (ekonomik şoklara yanıt vermek için) doğru karşılıkta vardır. Hükümetlerin ‘hızlı’ yanıt verdiğini söyleyen seçenek anlamı tersine çevirir; ortak bir araç ‘geliştirdi’ ifadesi, kur riskinin ‘sürdü’ğü iddiası ve para biriminden ‘ayrılmayı’ tartışma özgün cümlede yoktur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

In oral cultures, knowledge was preserved and transmitted through stories, songs and sayings that were memorised and repeated across generations.
options: Sözlü kültürlerde bilgi, ezberlenen ve kuşaktan kuşağa yinelenen öyküler, şarkılar ve deyişler aracılığıyla korunur ve aktarılırdı.
Sözlü kültürlerde öyküler ve şarkılar, bilgiyi korumaktan çok eğlence amacıyla kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılırdı.
Sözlü kültürlerdeki bilgiler, yazının icadıyla birlikte öykü ve şarkılardan kurtarılarak kayda geçirildi.
Sözlü kültürlerde yalnızca belirli kişiler öyküleri ve şarkıları ezberleyip başkalarına öğretme hakkına sahipti.
Kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılan öyküler ve şarkılar, sözlü kültürlerde bilginin zamanla değişmesine yol açardı.
questions.explanation: ‘Knowledge was preserved and transmitted’ (bilgi korunur ve aktarılırdı), ‘through stories, songs and sayings’ (öyküler, şarkılar ve deyişler aracılığıyla) ve ‘memorised and repeated across generations’ (ezberlenen ve kuşaktan kuşağa yinelenen) doğru karşılıkta eksiksizdir. ‘Eğlence’ amacını öne çıkaran seçenek, yazının ‘icadıyla’ kayda geçirilme, yalnızca belirli kişilere tanınan ‘hakkına’ ve bilginin ‘değişmesine’ yol açma iddiaları özgün cümlede yoktur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki Türkçe cümlenin anlamca en yakın İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Kentlerde yaşayan yaşlıların sayısındaki artış, sosyal hizmetlerin yeniden düzenlenmesini gerektirmektedir.
options: Social services in cities have been reorganised because fewer elderly people now live there.
Elderly people prefer to live in cities, where social services are better organised.
As social services are reorganised, more elderly people are expected to move to cities.
The increase in the number of elderly people living in cities requires social services to be reorganised.
The number of elderly people living in cities has increased despite the reorganisation of social services.
questions.explanation: ‘Sayısındaki artış’ (the increase in the number), ‘kentlerde yaşayan yaşlılar’ (elderly people living in cities) ve ‘yeniden düzenlenmesini gerektirmektedir’ (requires … to be reorganised) doğru karşılıkta vardır. Yaşlıların ‘fewer’ olduğunu söyleyen seçenek anlamı tersine çevirir; kentleri ‘prefer’ etme, kentlere ‘move’ etme beklentisi ve ‘despite’ ile kurulan karşıtlık özgün cümlede yoktur.

questions.text:
Aşağıdaki Türkçe cümlenin anlamca en yakın İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Bazı ekonomistlere göre gelir eşitsizliği, belirli bir düzeyi aştığında ekonomik büyümeyi yavaşlatabilir.
options: Some economists argue that economic growth inevitably increases income inequality beyond a certain level.
According to most economists, income inequality has no effect on economic growth at any level.
According to some economists, income inequality may slow down economic growth once it exceeds a certain level.

questions.passage:
Anyone who has promised to finish a report by Friday and delivered it the following Wednesday has experienced what psychologists call the planning fallacy: the tendency to underestimate the time, cost and effort that a future task will require, even when one knows that similar tasks in the past took longer than expected. The term was introduced in the late 1970s by Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky, and the phenomenon has since been documented in contexts ranging from students' essay deadlines to large public infrastructure projects, many of which are completed years late and well over budget.

What makes the bias puzzling is that it persists in the face of experience. One widely accepted explanation is that, when people plan, they adopt an 'inside view': they construct a mental scenario of how the task will unfold step by step, focusing on their intentions and on the specific features of the case at hand. Such scenarios tend to be optimistic because they leave little room for the interruptions, illnesses and unforeseen complications that typically disrupt real work. Past delays, meanwhile, are often attributed to unusual circumstances and are therefore judged irrelevant to the present plan. Motivation may also play a part, since an ambitious schedule can be attractive to someone who wishes to impress a supervisor or win a contract.

Interestingly, the bias seems to apply mainly to one's own projects. Observers who are asked to predict how long someone else will need tend to give more pessimistic, and frequently more accurate, estimates. This asymmetry has inspired a practical remedy known as reference-class forecasting. Instead of building a forecast from the details of the current project, planners first identify a set of comparable projects that have already been completed and use their actual outcomes as a baseline, adjusting it only modestly for the particular case. Although the technique cannot eliminate uncertainty, it has been adopted by several governments for evaluating large transport schemes, where even modest gains in accuracy may save considerable sums of public money.
questions.text: The passage is mainly concerned with ----.
options: a common tendency to underestimate the demands of future tasks, its likely causes and a way of reducing it
the reasons why large public infrastructure projects are usually cancelled
the careers of two psychologists who studied human decision-making
the advantages of setting ambitious deadlines in the workplace
the differences between the planning habits of students and professionals
questions.explanation: Metin planlama yanılgısını tanımlar, ‘inside view’ ve güdü gibi olası nedenlerini açıklar, sonunda ‘reference-class forecasting’ adlı çözümü anlatır; ana konu bu eğilim, nedenleri ve azaltma yoludur. Projelerin iptal (‘cancelled’) edilmesi metinde geçmez; iki psikoloğun ‘careers’ bilgisi yalnızca kaynak olarak anılır; iddialı takvimlerin ‘advantages’ı savunulmaz; öğrenciler ile ‘professionals’ arasında bir karşılaştırma da yapılmaz.

During the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, thousands of communities in Europe and North America were built, owned and governed almost entirely by a single employer. These company towns typically arose where industry needed labour in places with little or no existing settlement: around coal mines, timber mills and textile factories located near remote sources of power or raw materials. Because workers could not easily find housing elsewhere, the firm constructed homes, shops, schools and churches, and in many cases it also employed the local police and appointed the town's officials.

Contemporary observers disagreed sharply about what these arrangements represented. Some employers presented their towns as models of social progress, offering clean water, parks and libraries at a time when the slums of industrial cities were notorious for overcrowding and disease. A few such settlements, built by owners with strong philanthropic or religious convictions, did provide living conditions far superior to those available to most industrial workers. Critics, however, pointed out that the same benevolence served as a powerful instrument of control. Rent was deducted directly from wages, and in some mining towns workers were paid partly in scrip, a private currency that could be spent only at the company store, where prices were often higher than elsewhere. Since losing one's job usually meant losing one's home as well, workers who joined a trade union or took part in a strike risked eviction along with dismissal.

Historians today tend to see company towns as neither purely benevolent nor purely exploitative but as an expression of industrial paternalism, a system in which the employer assumed responsibility for workers' welfare in exchange for loyalty and obedience. Most of these towns declined in the second half of the twentieth century, when improved transport allowed workers to live at a distance from their workplaces and governments took over many of the welfare functions that employers had previously supplied.

options: industries needed workers but there was little existing settlement

questions.explanation: Metin şirket kentlerinin sanayinin işgücüne ihtiyaç duyduğu ama yerleşimin az olduğu ya da hiç olmadığı yerlerde, örneğin uzak madenlerin çevresinde kurulduğunu söyler. Sendikaların (‘trade unions’) güçlü olduğu söylenmez, tersine sendikaya katılmak cezalandırılırdı; refah hizmetlerini devletin (‘governments’) üstlenmesi kentlerin gerilemesiyle ilgilidir; kentlerin aşırı kalabalık (‘overcrowded’) olması yalnızca karşılaştırma olarak anılır; işçilerin uzakta oturmayı yeğlemesi (‘preferred’) ise sonraki dönemin gelişmesidir.

questions.passage:
Few events in economic life spread as quickly as a bank run. Because banks lend out most of the money deposited with them and keep only a fraction in reserve, no bank can repay all of its depositors at once. Under normal conditions this does not matter, since only a small proportion of customers wish to withdraw their savings on any given day. If, however, depositors begin to suspect that a bank may fail, each of them has a strong incentive to withdraw funds before others do, and the resulting rush can force even a fundamentally sound bank to sell its assets hastily at a loss and, ultimately, to close. In this sense a run can be self-fulfilling: the fear of collapse helps to bring about the very collapse that was feared. Economists formalised this insight in the early 1980s, and the work later contributed to a Nobel Prize.

The most widely adopted response has been deposit insurance, under which a public agency guarantees deposits up to a certain limit. The United States introduced a federal scheme in 1933, after thousands of banks had failed during the early years of the Great Depression, and comparable systems now operate in most countries. By removing the reason to rush to the bank, a credible guarantee makes runs far less likely, and it seldom needs to be used precisely because depositors believe in it.

The protection is not without costs, however. Critics argue that insured depositors have little reason to monitor how their bank invests their money, which may encourage banks to take excessive risks in the knowledge that losses will partly be borne by the public. This problem, known as moral hazard, is usually addressed through regulation, including capital requirements and regular supervision. Recent episodes have also raised new questions, since online banking allows large sums to be withdrawn within hours, and deposits above the insured limit, typically held by businesses, remain vulnerable to a sudden loss of confidence.

questions.passage:
For more than a thousand years, entry into the upper ranks of government in imperial China depended largely on success in a series of written examinations. The system is usually traced to the Sui dynasty at the beginning of the seventh century, although it became central to the selection of officials only under later dynasties, and it was formally abolished in 1905. Candidates were tested chiefly on their knowledge of the Confucian classics and on their ability to compose essays in a highly prescribed style, and they progressed through local, provincial and metropolitan levels, at each of which only a small fraction succeeded.

In principle, the examinations were open to most adult men regardless of family background, and this feature has often been cited as an early example of selection by merit. Accounts of officials from humble origins who rose to high office through years of study circulated widely and reinforced the ideal. Historians, however, have qualified this picture. Preparing for the examinations required many years of education that only fairly prosperous families could afford, and lineages that had already produced successful candidates were able to pool resources, hire tutors and build libraries for their younger members. As a result, although some genuine upward mobility did occur, a large proportion of degree holders appear to have come from families with previous connections to officialdom or landed wealth.

The influence of the system extended well beyond government. Because an examination degree conferred prestige and legal privileges even on those who never received an official post, it shaped the ambitions of a large section of society and helped to create a shared culture among the educated elite across a vast territory. Some scholars have also argued that reports about the Chinese examinations encouraged the introduction of competitive entry into the civil service in several European countries during the nineteenth century, although the extent of this influence remains a matter of debate.

options: their practical experience in local government
the wealth and reputation of their families
their knowledge of classical texts and their skill in writing essays in a fixed form

their knowledge of European administrative systems

questions.passage:
In the late 1960s, two American researchers reported a striking result. After giving pupils at an elementary school a test that was described to teachers as a measure of future intellectual 'blooming', they told the teachers that certain children, who had in fact been chosen at random, could be expected to make unusual progress. When the children were tested again at the end of the year, some of those labelled as promising, particularly in the youngest classes, appeared to have gained more than their classmates. The researchers concluded that teachers' expectations had become a self-fulfilling prophecy, and the finding, often called the Pygmalion effect, quickly spread beyond academic journals into teacher training and popular culture.

The original study, however, attracted considerable methodological criticism. Critics noted that the test used was poorly suited to very young children and that the overall effect depended heavily on a small number of pupils with unusually large gains. Attempts to reproduce the result produced mixed outcomes, and later reviews of the research concluded that expectation effects do exist but are, on average, considerably smaller than early accounts implied.

More recent work has shifted attention from whether such effects occur to when and for whom they matter. Expectations appear to influence pupils mainly through everyday classroom behaviour: teachers may unknowingly give the students they regard as able more time to answer, more challenging material and warmer feedback. Several studies suggest that these effects are stronger for pupils from stigmatised groups and for those who are new to a teacher, since in such cases teachers have less information and may rely more heavily on stereotypes or first impressions. Researchers have therefore argued that, although a teacher's beliefs alone cannot transform a pupil's ability, small differences in treatment could accumulate and contribute to existing educational inequalities, especially if they persist over several years.

options: the design of reliable intelligence tests for very young children
how a well-known claim about the effect of teachers’ expectations has been revised by later research

the careers of two researchers who studied classroom behaviour

Güvenilir test tasarımı (‘design’) yalnızca bir eleştiri olarak geçer; öğretmen eğitiminin araştırmayı yok saydığı (‘ignore’) söylenmez, tersine bulgu eğitime yayılmıştır; üstün yetenekli öğrencileri belirleme yöntemi (‘gifted’) ve araştırmacıların kariyeri (‘careers’) konu edilmez.

questions.passage: Common sense suggests that a person who has just done something good will be inclined to continue behaving well. ---- In laboratory studies, participants who were first given the opportunity to express egalitarian views or to recall a past good deed were subsequently more willing to behave selfishly or to make choices that could appear prejudiced. Psychologists explain this pattern by suggesting that a recent virtuous act provides a kind of moral credit, which people feel entitled to spend. The size and reliability of the effect are still debated, however, and some replication attempts have found it to be weaker than first reported.
questions.text: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: As a result, charities rarely ask the same donors for money twice.
This is why most people consider themselves more honest than average.
Similarly, people who behave badly tend to continue doing so for years.
Laboratory participants are usually recruited from among university students.
Some research, however, points to the opposite tendency, known as moral licensing.
questions.explanation: İlk cümle sağduyuya göre iyi davranışın iyi davranışı sürdüreceğini söyler; ardından gelen deneyler ise iyi bir davranıştan sonra bencilliğin arttığını gösterir. Bu karşıtlığı ‘however’ ile kuran ve kavramı adlandıran ‘moral licensing’ cümlesi gelmelidir. Bağış isteyen kurumlar (‘charities’) ve kişilerin kendini dürüst (‘honest’) sayması konu dışıdır; kötü davranışın sürmesi (‘behave badly’) deneylerle bağlanmaz; katılımcıların öğrencilerden seçilmesi (‘recruited’) ise akışı bozan bir yöntem ayrıntısıdır.

questions.passage: Economists insist that rational decisions should be based only on future costs and benefits. Money, time or effort that has already been spent and cannot be recovered is, in their terminology, a sunk cost, and it should have no bearing on what one does next. ---- A person who has paid for a concert ticket may attend the performance despite feeling ill, simply because the ticket would otherwise be 'wasted'; similarly, governments sometimes continue to fund failing projects because abandoning them would seem to admit that earlier spending was a mistake.
questions.text: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Concert tickets have become considerably more expensive in recent decades.
For this reason, most governments now evaluate projects carefully before approving them.
Consequently, people rarely regret the money they have already spent.
In practice, however, people frequently allow such past investments to influence their choices.
Future benefits, on the other hand, are usually easy to estimate accurately.
questions.explanation: Önceki cümleler kuramı (geri alınamayan maliyetin karara etkisi olmamalı) anlatır, sonraki cümle ise bilet ve başarısız proje örnekleriyle insanların buna uymadığını gösterir; araya ‘In practice, however’ ile bu karşıtlığı kuran cümle gelir. Biletlerin pahalılaşması (‘expensive’) konu dışıdır; hükümetlerin projeleri dikkatle değerlendirmesi (‘evaluate’) ve insanların harcamalarından pişmanlık duymaması (‘regret’) örneklerle çelişir; gelecekteki yararların kolay tahmin edilmesi (‘easy to estimate’) de örneklere bağlanmaz.

questions.passage: For a long time, professional historians regarded spoken testimony with suspicion, preferring documents that had been written at the time of the events they described. ---- Since the mid-twentieth century, however, oral history has become an established method, especially for studying groups whose experiences rarely entered official archives, such as factory workers, migrants and rural women. Practitioners do not claim that interviews are free from error; instead, they argue that the way people remember and narrate the past is itself valuable evidence of how events were understood and given meaning.
questions.text: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Written documents, by contrast, were often destroyed during wars and revolutions.
Factory workers in the nineteenth century were seldom able to read or write.
Today, many interviews are recorded and stored in digital archives.
Memories, they argued, are reshaped over time and may be influenced by later events or by the expectations of the interviewer.
As a result, oral history was the dominant method in universities for most of the century.
questions.explanation: Boşluk, tarihçilerin sözlü tanıklığa neden kuşkuyla baktığını açıklamalıdır: Anıların zamanla değiştiğini ve görüşmeciden etkilenebildiğini söyleyen cümle bu gerekçeyi verir ve sonraki ‘free from error’ ifadesine de bağlanır. Yazılı belgelerin yok edilmesi (‘destroyed’) sözlü tarihi destekleyen bir gerekçedir ve ‘however’ öncesine uymaz; işçilerin okuryazarlığı (‘read or write’) ve görüşmelerin dijital arşivlenmesi (‘digital archives’) akışı bozar; sözlü tarihin baskın yöntem (‘dominant’) olduğu iddiası ise ilk cümleyle çelişir.

questions.passage: The plague epidemic that swept across Europe between 1347 and 1351 is estimated to have killed between a third and a half of the continent’s population. ---- With far fewer people available to work the land, surviving labourers were able to demand higher wages and better conditions, and many moved in search of more favourable terms. Authorities in England and elsewhere attempted to freeze wages at their pre-plague levels by law, but such measures proved difficult to enforce, and in the following decades real wages in many regions rose markedly.
questions.text: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: The disease is now known to have been caused by a bacterium carried by fleas.
For those who survived, however, its economic consequences were in some respects surprisingly favourable.
Medieval doctors had no effective treatment for the infection.
Many towns had already begun to build hospitals before the epidemic arrived.
As a result, landowners found it easier than ever to hire labourers cheaply.
questions.explanation: İlk cümle salgının büyük can kaybını anlatır; sonraki cümleler ise hayatta kalan işçilerin daha yüksek ücret ve daha iyi koşullar elde ettiğini gösterir. Araya ‘however’ ile bu beklenmedik olumlu ekonomik sonucu tanıtan cümle gelmelidir. Hastalığın nedeni (‘bacterium’), hekimlerin tedavisi (‘treatment’) ve hastaneler (‘hospitals’) tıbbi ayrıntılardır, ücret konusuna geçişi sağlamaz; işçileri ucuza çalıştırmanın kolaylaştığı (‘cheaply’) iddiası ise sonraki cümlelerle çelişir.

questions.passage: Boredom has traditionally been treated as a trivial or even shameful state, a sign that a person lacks curiosity or inner resources. ---- On this view, the unpleasant feeling of boredom functions much like hunger or pain: it signals that the current activity is no longer rewarding and motivates the individual to seek a more meaningful or stimulating one. Those who hold this view caution, however, that chronic boredom is a different matter, as it has been associated with problems such as impulsive behaviour.
questions.text: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Some psychologists, however, now argue that it may serve a useful purpose.
Children, for example, are often bored during long car journeys.
Hunger and pain are processed in different regions of the brain.
Consequently, bored people tend to perform well on repetitive tasks.
Most modern workplaces have tried to eliminate repetitive tasks altogether.
questions.explanation: İlk cümle can sıkıntısının geleneksel olarak önemsiz sayıldığını söyler; ‘On this view’ ile başlayan cümle ise onun yararlı bir işaret işlevi gördüğünü savunan bir görüşü açıklar. Bu yüzden boşluğa ‘however’ ile karşıt görüşü tanıtan ‘useful purpose’ cümlesi gelmelidir. Çocukların yolculukta sıkılması (‘car journeys’) ‘this view’ ifadesine dayanak olmaz; açlık ve acının beyindeki yeri (‘regions of the brain’) konu dışıdır; tekrarlayan işlerde başarı (‘perform well’) ve iş yerlerinin bu işleri kaldırması (‘workplaces’) da akışa bağlanmaz.

questions.passage: In early modern England, the most widely owned printed book after the Bible was probably not a work of literature or theology but the almanac. ---- Alongside a calendar, these inexpensive booklets typically contained tables of sunrise and sunset, the dates of fairs and markets, advice on planting and medical treatment, and astrological predictions for the coming year. Because they were bought annually and quickly discarded, relatively few copies survive, yet historians value them as evidence of the practical knowledge and beliefs of ordinary readers.
questions.text: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: By some estimates, hundreds of thousands of copies were sold each year, reaching readers far beyond the educated elite.
The Bible had been translated into English several decades earlier.
Astrology was eventually rejected by most scholars in the eighteenth century.
Farmers, in particular, relied on weather lore passed down by their parents.
As a result, few people outside London could afford to buy them.
questions.explanation: İlk cümle almanakların en yaygın sahip olunan basılı kitap olduğunu söyler; boşluğa bu yaygınlığı rakamla destekleyen ve ‘these inexpensive booklets’ ifadesine zemin hazırlayan ‘hundreds of thousands of copies’ cümlesi gelmelidir. İncil’in çevirisi (‘translated’) ve astrolojinin reddedilmesi (‘rejected’) konudan sapar ve sonraki ‘these booklets’ göndermesini koparır; çiftçilerin kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılan bilgisi (‘weather lore’) almanaklarla ilgisizdir; kitapların pahalı olduğunu ima eden ‘afford’ cümlesi ise ‘inexpensive’ ile çelişir.

questions.passage: (I) The term 'impostor phenomenon' was introduced in 1978 by two psychologists to describe high-achieving individuals who remain convinced that their success is undeserved. (II) Such people tend to attribute their accomplishments to luck, timing or other people's mistaken judgement, and they fear being exposed as frauds. (III) Psychologists have developed a wide range of personality tests, some of which are now used by employers during recruitment. (IV) Although the experience was first described among professional women, later studies have found that it is common among men as well. (V) Researchers emphasise that it is not a clinical diagnosis but a pattern of thinking that often coexists with anxiety and perfectionism.

II
III
IV

III numaralı cümle işverenlerin kullandığı kişilik testlerine geçerek konudan sapar. I kavramı tanıtır, II ‘Such people’ ile I’e bağlanır, IV olgunun kimlerde görüldüğünü açıklar, V ise ‘it’ ile aynı olguyu nitelendirir.

questions.passage: (I) Developed by an Italian physician in the early twentieth century, the Montessori method is based on the idea that children learn best when they are free to choose their own activities. (II) Classrooms typically contain specially designed materials that children can handle independently, and pupils of different ages often work together. (III) Teachers act as guides who observe each child closely and introduce new materials when the child appears ready for them. (IV) Maria Montessori was among the first women in Italy to qualify as a doctor, and she later lived for some years in Spain, India and the Netherlands. (V) Studies comparing Montessori and conventional schools have produced mixed results, partly because the quality of implementation varies considerably.

options: I
II
III
IV
V
questions.explanation: Paragraf Montessori yönteminin temel düşüncesini, sınıf düzenini, öğretmenin rolünü ve yöntemin etkisine ilişkin araştırmaları anlatır. IV numaralı cümle Maria Montessori’nin yaşam öyküsüne ve yaşadığı ülkelere geçerek yöntemden sapar. I yöntemi tanıtır, II sınıftaki malzemeleri, III öğretmenin rehberliğini açıklar, V ise yöntemin sonuçlarını değerlendirerek konuyu sürdürür.

questions.passage: (I) In the 1930s, maps prepared for a United States federal housing agency graded urban neighbourhoods according to their supposed lending risk, and areas with large Black or immigrant populations were frequently outlined in red.
